paper.supports: Conditional structured sampling, empirical marginals/dependencies, normalized composite indices, cohort quintiles, oversampling and distribution checks.
paper.limit: Undergraduate admissions. It does not provide PhD distributions or use an LLM to generate the underlying applicant records.

paper_code.supports: Seeds, quantile construction and inverse-frequency sampling without replacement.
paper_code.limit: The original sampling cells are SES by performance. Pathway by performance is a PhD implementation assumption.

uw.supports: Academic preparation, research duration, responsibility, outputs, methods and program fit. Two years of research is one high-category anchor.
uw.limit: A 2020 illustrative, broad graduate rubric, not a current ML admissions threshold or frequency estimate. GRE thresholds are not imported.

brandeis.location: What We Look For (the original PDF link was unavailable; the official page contains the rubric)
brandeis.supports: Relevant coursework, quantitative preparation, substantive research contributions, relevant methods, outputs and faculty fit. Thesis-equivalent research can support the high research category; a publication is not mandatory.
brandeis.limit: Psychology rubric: transfer dimensions, not psychology-specific courses or claims about ML competitiveness. Essays and letters provide evidence a CV alone cannot supply.

penn.supports: Reported mean GPA among admitted CIS applicants: 3.70 in 2023, 3.78 in 2022 and 3.80 in 2021.
penn.limit: Admitted students only, not the applicant-pool distribution, an ML-only population, a minimum GPA or a standard deviation. Not a calibration target for the full synthetic pool.

cmu_2015.supports: No parameter is derived from this link.
cmu_2015.limit: Older secondary repost; not used for numerical calibration or current admissions thresholds.

project.supports: CS PhD opportunity, academic preparation, research potential, fit, recommendation strength and fixed credentials across integrity conditions.
project.limit: This component makes CVs only. It does not fabricate recommendation letters or change treatment conditions.

user.supports: Proposed strong/borderline/weak examples, PhD-only scope, OpenAI with a configurable model, and provisional numerical values for review.
user.limit: Providing provisional values does not establish empirical calibration or authorize execution.

fit.limit: Research area is visible evidence only; no specific faculty/lab is supplied, so actual faculty fit is not scored.

work_and_internships.limit: Nontechnical work does not by itself imply weak research potential.

letters_and_essays.limit: Outside the CV-only scope; no letter strength, writing quality, personal character or essay score is invented.

parameters.note: Original cohort defaults; not a requirement to execute that many records.
Implementation dates chosen to accommodate the plan's 2026 coursework incidents; these exact dates are assumptions.
A synthetic preparation variable and pathway mix, not measured PhD frequencies or the paper's income variable.
Binning/rank alignment comes from the method; all PhD bin boundaries, masses and correlation settings are assumptions. Penn means cannot determine them.
Qualitative rubric anchors inform duration and responsibility; five levels and their full intervals are implementation assumptions.

contribution_by_preparation: formulated a research question and led method development

parameters.note: Output fields are rubric-supported. Binomial probabilities, six-month opportunities, caps and venue/author mixtures are not reported PhD statistics.
User-proposed dimensions; all numerical relationships require review.
Explicit CS course/grade patterns operationalize relevant and quantitative preparation; they are not sampled transcripts or inferred from GPA.

Index construction is transferred; coefficients on PhD features, normalization choices, quintile-to-strength mapping and pathway strata are unvalidated adaptations. The paper's coefficients are not PhD importance weights.
Optional CV wording and factual checks, additional to the paper's structured profiles. No model is selected automatically.

remaining_assumptions: Generic institutions, venues and employers; program-specific prestige is not modeled.
Template degree dates; three-month internships; research and work hours and work-duration mixtures are template assumptions in sampling.py.
Research periods are consecutive, do not overlap, and end at the review month; publications cannot precede their linked research.
Strength is a provisional cohort-relative label, not an admit/reject truth or a guaranteed publication-count pattern.
No empirical PhD joint distribution is supplied; distribution summaries are descriptive validation, not a fitted population claim.
